evidence_title: Continuing connected transactions exceeded and revised annual cap
evidence_summary: FY2025 connected procurement reached RMB547.8338m versus the RMB365m annual cap because of internal statistical-processing errors. The issuer disclosed monthly monitoring, a 70% warning threshold, training, auditor review and INED review; the applicable percentage ratio was below 5% and interested directors abstained.
next_required_evidence: Confirm remediation effectiveness, recurrence, pricing controls and whether subsequent caps remain compliant.
monitor_trigger: Any repeated cap exceedance, regulatory action, adverse auditor/INED finding or materially larger connected exposure.

evidence_summary: Q1 2026 revenue declined 4.5% year on year while profit attributable to ordinary shareholders increased 4.8%; healthcare operating efficiency improved and asset quality was described as stable. This is mixed current operating evidence, not a dated consensus-revision series.
next_required_evidence: Capture interim results and a reliable dated consensus/guidance revision series before stronger earnings-direction inference.
monitor_trigger: Interim results, management guidance or material change in hospital profitability/asset quality.

evidence_title: Administrative supervisory measures received by a subsidiary
evidence_summary: Shanghai CSRC identified misleading marketing, false or inaccurate live-broadcast content, inadequate compliance/risk controls and unregistered personnel providing investment advice. The subsidiary was required to rectify and suspend new-customer acquisition for three months. Governance risk is material but is represented once at security level through the linked operating/earnings event.
next_required_evidence: Verify remediation completion, recurrence risk, restored acquisition compliance and any further regulator action.
monitor_trigger: Further supervisory action, delayed remediation, renewed customer-acquisition restriction or control failures.

evidence_summary: The issuer warned that H1 2026 revenue was approximately RMB1,298.9m versus RMB2,099.7m, adjusted net profit approximately RMB107-117m versus RMB912.5m, and attributable net profit approximately RMB25-35m versus RMB865.4m. The principal cause was the regulatory suspension of new-customer acquisition; acquisition had resumed by 29 July. This fresh negative signal supersedes the stale February positive-alert direction for current decision readiness.
next_required_evidence: Require H1 results, post-resumption acquisition economics, margin recovery and evidence that compliance remediation is durable before releasing the blocker.
monitor_trigger: H1 2026 results, post-resumption customer acquisition, profitability recovery or further regulatory action.

evidence_summary: Q1 2026 revenue increased 10.02% and reported attributable profit increased 479.67%, but the jump was driven materially by biological-asset fair-value gains while the laboratory-services business remained loss-making. New orders rose about 111.6% and backlog about 40.9%, providing recovery evidence but not yet clean core-margin confirmation.
next_required_evidence: Confirm interim core operating margin, cash conversion and whether order/backlog growth converts into laboratory-services profitability.
monitor_trigger: H1 results, core laboratory-services margin, cash flow, order conversion or another explicit profit warning/alert.
